changelog.title: The Extraction
changelog.description: 1616 modules were trapped in catalog limbo — visible to no hub, reachable by no path. We built four new tools to find them, classified every one, and brought them home. Zero strict orphans remain. The Matrix is empty; everyone is here.

changelog.title: The Glitch in the Matrix
changelog.description: A déjà vu of broken progress: 70 modules across WSA and A+ Core 2 had been silently overwriting each other's completion records since launch. Students who finished the work received credit for one. The fix renames sixty-five files to write module-scoped keys. The era of phantom completion ends.

changelog.title: The Sentinels
changelog.description: Six new EduScan validators — PROG-003, CAT-006, CAT-007, TAG-001, TAG-002, HUB-001 — patrol the platform for the bug class that bit us. Every catalog change is now mechanically verified. The Sentinels see what passes, and what passes does not pass twice.

changelog.title: The Construct
changelog.description: Eight per-house incubator hubs — one per powered house — absorb 489 orphan modules across 267 sub-clusters. Loading program: when a topic reaches ten cohesive modules, it graduates to a dedicated hub. Until then it lives where students can find it.

changelog.title: Three New Hubs
changelog.description: The Database Track (35 SQL modules), Bash Mastery (14 lab missions), and CMMC 2.0 Domain (15 compliance applets) emerge as fully-curated curriculum surfaces. Three more wings of the city, lit and named.

changelog.title: The Investigator's Wing
changelog.description: Forensics relocates from the city's outer ring into House of the Eye. Three certification hubs — CHFI, GCFA, GCFE — go live with full module mapping. Old URLs 301-redirect home. Every detective gets a desk.

changelog.title: Matrix Awakens
changelog.description: House of the Matrix declares its powerhouse status: Advanced Linux Administration (CTS4321C), Operator Python Missions, Protocore, PiVerse — twenty-four modules registered, three tracks active. The construct is loaded. The training is ready.

changelog.title: The Factionless Find a House
changelog.description: Divergent — the warehouse of those who fit no single faction — formalizes as a powerhouse. CIS2253 Cybersecurity Ethics, CIS4253 Ethics in IT, CIS2208 Cybersecurity Policy. The unclassifiable now have an address.

changelog.title: The Guardian
changelog.description: Three layers of pre-deploy safety: a documented audit of every change against student progress, a mechanical verifier that exits non-zero on unknown progress-key changes, a Firestore snapshot tool for individual record recovery. We do not destroy. We make destruction impossible.
